label: Selected q44 source supply by aligning the actual ancestor with p
meaning: For each participant the seven ancestry/composition/reception inputs supply a distinct actual identity ancestor and its own-being causal responsibility. Existing at-most-one actual identity and the selected actual identity witness identify that ancestor with the same p. This is selection of the supplied ancestor, not identification of every possible own-being cause with p. No backwards OwnBeing-to-identity dictionary or IsGod uniqueness is used.

strong_version_needed.b4987085-f7b0-4031-a795-364873d3c216: Composition is applied by Q44SourceSupply.causeOfChain along an arbitrary finite chain of actual esse causes (TransGen ActualEsseCause), at every link. The weak version PerSeComposition (7648194d) composes only when the later link is per se (PerSeActualEsseCause … AsCaused). This theorem has no AsCaused relation and no premise makes the chain links per se.
